invariants_audited: No CVV/card number reaches persistent memory
No authentication/session/API token reaches persistent memory
Webpage content cannot create trusted memory
Remote model cannot directly create trusted memory
Memory cannot directly authorize a browser target
Stale memory cannot become an executable target

observations.memory_context_minimization: Memory hints are injected into PlannerContextBuilder but are explicitly marked as expendable. If the 2KB budget is exceeded, memory hints are trimmed before active DOM detections, ensuring current browser context always has priority.
observations.memory_retriever: MemoryRetriever successfully retrieves Working and Semantic memory hints deterministically based on SiteScope. It does not return executable targets, only semantic hints for the LLM.
observations.storage_persistence: chrome.storage.local implementation includes deterministic eviction (oldest first) and enforces MAX_MEMORY_ITEMS and MAX_GLOBAL_BYTES limits. M8 firewall prevents raw sensitive values from being written.
observations.telemetry: PlannerTelemetryLogger successfully records explicit memory observables (memoryInfluencedPlanning, memoryMetadata), allowing distinct identification of memory influence vs. actual authorization.
